description: This file contains helper functions for managing Kubernetes core resources, including resource name validation, quota scope validation, resource request handling, toleration and taint processing, and volume class retrieval.

methods.name: IsHugePageResourceName
methods.description: Checks if the resource name has the huge page resource prefix.

methods.name: IsHugePageResourceValueDivisible
methods.description: Determines if the resource value of storage is an integer multiple of the page size.

methods.name: IsQuotaHugePageResourceName
methods.description: Checks if the resource name has the quota-related huge page resource prefix.

methods.name: HugePageResourceName
methods.description: Returns a ResourceName with the canonical hugepage prefix for a given page size.

methods.name: HugePageSizeFromResourceName
methods.description: Extracts the page size from a huge page resource name.

methods.name: NonConvertibleFields
methods.description: Filters annotations to include only keys with the 'non-convertible.kubernetes.io' prefix.

methods.name: Semantic
methods.description: Provides semantic deep equality checks for core objects.

methods.name: IsStandardResourceQuotaScope
methods.description: Checks if a scope is a standard resource quota scope.

methods.name: IsResourceQuotaScopeValidForResource
methods.description: Validates if a resource applies to a specific quota scope.

methods.name: IsStandardContainerResourceName
methods.description: Checks if a resource name is a standard container resource request.

methods.name: IsExtendedResourceName
methods.description: Determines if a resource name is an extended resource.

methods.name: IsNativeResource
methods.description: Checks if a resource name is in the 'kubernetes.io' namespace.

methods.name: IsOvercommitAllowed
methods.description: Checks if overcommit is allowed for a resource.

methods.name: IsStandardLimitRangeType
methods.description: Checks if a limit range type is standard (Pod or Container).

methods.name: IsStandardQuotaResourceName
methods.description: Checks if a resource name is recognized by the quota system.

methods.name: IsStandardResourceName
methods.description: Checks if a resource name is a standard resource.

methods.name: IsIntegerResourceName
methods.description: Checks if a resource is measured in integer values.

methods.name: IsServiceIPSet
methods.description: Checks if a Service's ClusterIP is set.

methods.name: IsStandardFinalizerName
methods.description: Checks if a finalizer name is standard.

methods.name: GetAccessModesAsString
methods.description: Converts an array of access modes to a string.

methods.name: GetAccessModesFromString
methods.description: Parses a string to an array of access modes.

methods.name: ClaimContainsAllocatedResources
methods.description: Checks if a PersistentVolumeClaim has allocated resources.

methods.name: ClaimContainsAllocatedResourceStatus
methods.description: Checks if a PersistentVolumeClaim has allocated resource statuses.

methods.name: GetTolerationsFromPodAnnotations
methods.description: Deserializes tolerations from Pod annotations.

methods.name: AddOrUpdateTolerationInPod
methods.description: Adds or updates a toleration in a Pod's toleration list.

methods.name: GetTaintsFromNodeAnnotations
methods.description: Deserializes taints from Node annotations.

methods.name: GetPersistentVolumeClass
methods.description: Retrieves the StorageClassName of a PersistentVolume.

methods.name: GetPersistentVolumeClaimClass
methods.description: Retrieves the StorageClassName of a PersistentVolumeClaim.

methods.name: PersistentVolumeClaimHasClass
methods.description: Checks if a PersistentVolumeClaim has a StorageClassName set.

methods.name: GetDeletionCostFromPodAnnotations
methods.description: Retrieves the pod deletion cost from annotations.

methods.name: HasInvalidLabelValueInNodeSelectorTerms
methods.description: Checks for invalid label values in NodeSelectorTerms.
